[RARC.2.2] Within a single process, several engines may coexist and
exchange facts by direct calls: the integrator takes the upward `publish` one
engine delivers on its stream and asserts it into the next tier's engine.
Across processes, the integrator wires whatever transport it likes — local
sockets, a message broker, gRPC, cross-host RPC. The engine has no protocol
surface; the integrator is the bridge.
